header.title: Loss of Jensen's backstops risks contraction in the neocloud/neolab ecosystem

s01_bottom_line.text: SemiAnalysis argues Nvidia's $530B of off-balance-sheet guarantees (including $36B take-or-pay floors) and backstop program let non-investment-grade neoclouds borrow at IG pricing because Jensen personally backed them; without the Jensen put there might be a large contraction in this ecosystem.
The article explicitly warns of a large ecosystem contraction if the Jensen put disappears.

If the next CEO cannot or will not extend the same credit support, neocloud financing and buildout could shrink, reducing demand for GPUs and datacenter physical suppliers; the article does not quantify the contraction.

Guarantees include $36B of take-or-pay floors under neocloud capacity
